from primitive_api import (
    query_symbolic_state,
    list_executable_actions,
    validate_program_step,
    execute_program_step,
    check_activity_success,
    write_evidence,
)

before = check_activity_success()
remote_state = query_symbolic_state("remote_control")
actions = list_executable_actions("remote_control", limit=30)
trace = []

grab = "[GRAB] <remote_control> (1000)"
walk = "[WALK] <remote_control> (1000)"

if not before.get("success"):
    if grab not in actions and walk in actions:
        validation = validate_program_step(walk)
        result = execute_program_step(walk) if validation.get("valid_action") else None
        status = check_activity_success()
        trace.append({
            "action": walk,
            "valid": validation.get("valid_action"),
            "executed": None if result is None else result.get("valid"),
            "status": status,
        })
        actions = list_executable_actions("remote_control", limit=30)

    status = check_activity_success()
    if not status.get("success") and grab in actions:
        validation = validate_program_step(grab)
        result = execute_program_step(grab) if validation.get("valid_action") else None
        status = check_activity_success()
        trace.append({
            "action": grab,
            "valid": validation.get("valid_action"),
            "executed": None if result is None else result.get("valid"),
            "status": status,
        })

after = check_activity_success()
write_evidence("acquire_remote_control", {
    "before": before,
    "remote_state": remote_state,
    "trace": trace,
    "after": after,
})
print({"trace": trace, "status": after})
